questions.prompt: What will the work in Margate help the museum do?
options: Move its collections into the post office.
Protect collections and improve public visits.
Share its rooms with the local post office.
Prepare the town hall for postal services.
questions.explanationZh: s4—s5说明马盖特博物馆将保护馆藏并改善公众参观。邮局属于布莱克浦。

questions.prompt: Which building is planned as a community-led cultural centre?
options: The town hall beside the museum.
The former post office in Blackpool.
questions.explanationZh: s7—s8明确将布莱克浦旧邮局改造成社区主导的文化创意中心。

questions.prompt: What does the first stage in Blackpool focus on?
options: Making the structure safe and developing plans.
Opening new exhibitions and selling tickets.
Moving the museum collections into new rooms.
Training guides and arranging public visits.
questions.explanationZh: s9说明首阶段用于加固结构并推进计划，其他选项不是文中所述工程。
